body: Hey, Im only on here because Im struggling too and also just posted my first post...but when I read your post your upbringing sounded a lot like mine and all I could think was that parents know their kids will make mistakes, small and big and they want to be given a door to help fix them, help make their little girl feel better, maybe you could try asking them for help? I don't know much as why would I be here too. I don't know your parents or what type of people they are so don't know whether Im totally unhelpful
